EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority)PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERALGovernment Notifications
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

IN the event of any potential disruption to the delivery of postal voting material, official poll cards or any other documentsrelated to the poll by post, at the Local Authorities Elections 2018 Scheduled to be held under Chapter 262 of LocalAuthorities Elections Ordinance, as amended by the Amendment Acts Nos. 9 of 1963, 24 of 1977, 24 of 1967, 25 of 1990 and22 of 2012 , it is hereby notified that it is lawful for the Elections Commission to get such activities carried out through agovernment institution or government officers or servants or through any other method adopted and it is the responsibilityof such officer to assist the Commission as directed.

This directive is issued under the powers vested with the Elections Commission, by the Article 104B (2) of the Constitutionof the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and provisions in the Ordinance mentioned above.
MAHINDA DESHAPRIYA,N. J. ABEYSEKERA,S. RATNAJEEVAN H. HOOLE,Chairman.Member.Member.
Elections Secretariat,Sarana Mawatha,Rajagiriya,On this 05th day of January, 2018.
